name: Hwasong-11
source: Screening estimate. DPRK Hwasong-11 (US designator KN-23) short-range ballistic missile, Iskander-M (9K720) analog: depressed/quasi-ballistic ~50 km apogee, ~450-690 km range, terminal pull-up maneuver, Mach ~6-7. Non-separating unitary airframe. No published aero/thermal fit - values are open-source order-of-magnitude estimates.
notes: Reentry mode: this object was characterised flying damped_glide; the shipped default is the neutral equilibrium_glide. Select the intended reentry mode in the Reentry-mode dropdown (the glide law is a flight-plan choice, not object hardware).
